# Uchit Vyas

> Enterprise architect and forward-deployed platform engineer based in Melbourne, Australia. 15+ years across enterprise architecture, cloud, DevSecOps, SRE, GenAI and platform engineering — embedded with delivery teams getting regulated platforms into production against fixed external deadlines. 5 books with Apress & Packt. US patent (Specs Monster, US11334348B2). Named on the Top 50 DevSecOps Influencers list. Site at https://hellouchit.com.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) — a structured manifest of the site's most important content, optimised for ingestion by AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.).

## Open source

- [Open source index](https://hellouchit.com/oss/): All projects, with what each enforces and how to run it
- [mcp-regulated-ai-compliance](https://github.com/uchit/mcp-regulated-ai-compliance): Model Context Protocol server exposing this site's compliance dataset — 6 tools, 53 resources, 5 prompts — callable from Claude, Cursor, Zed, Continue and other MCP clients. Apache 2.0, published on npm as `@hellouchit/mcp-regulated-ai-compliance` with sigstore provenance.
- [opa-nist-ai-rmf](https://github.com/uchit/opa-nist-ai-rmf): OPA policy bundle implementing NIST AI RMF + GenAI Profile, enforced at deploy time

## Machine-readable exports (CC BY 4.0)

The interactive tooling is published as JSON as well as HTML, so it can be
cited, forked and embedded without scraping. Attribution: Uchit Vyas —
hellouchit.com.

- [Diagnostics JSON](https://hellouchit.com/tools/diagnostics.json): 6 diagnostics — every capability, scored level, recommendation and framework citation
- [Decision trees JSON](https://hellouchit.com/decisions/decisions.json): 7 trees, ADR-shaped — verdicts, trade-offs, watch-outs, when-not-to-pick
- [Anti-patterns JSON](https://hellouchit.com/anti-patterns/anti-patterns.json): 15 named failure modes — where each appears, why it fails, what to do instead
- [Glossary JSON](https://hellouchit.com/glossary/glossary.json): 59 practitioner terms with domain tags
- [Dataset JSON](https://hellouchit.com/dataset/dataset.json): 56 controls × 28 regulations × 261 tools
